mainEntity.name: How can I choose the right contractor for my exterior restoration project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, look for companies with a strong track record in exterior restoration, positive client testimonials, and proper licensing and insurance. Obtain multiple bids, ensuring each bid details the scope of work, materials, and timeline. A clear communication process and a contractor's willingness to explain the restoration stages are practical tradeoffs that ensure a smooth project.
